items.title: Find an expert
items.text:
These companies know Xolo and offer support: installation, hosting, training, plugin development. The project lists them, it does not mandate them and takes no cut of the work.

CadolesSponsor

Deploys Xolo on your own infrastructure: on-site installation, integration with your existing systems and team training. Also offers dedicated instances, which it operates for you.

cadoles.com →

BeeWiiSponsor

Building an AI platform for companies, with Xolo as one of its building blocks. Open today as a SaaS pilot programme: no infrastructure to run on your side.

beewii.fr →

To appear on this page, open a request on the project repository.
